rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=18, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-14 NFE (steps) lever, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: n_cg plateau found at init_t0.005: n_cg18->hr0.0768(BEST), 20->0.0760, 15->0.0695, 25->0.043. Prior near-off at init_t0.005; the CG-DC is doing the work (DC runs once per Euler step). (2) FAILURE MODE: at steps=8 the recon may still benefit from more interleaved DC re-projections; OR fewer steps suffice (prior off). (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_steps 8 -> 16 (double the Euler steps = double the CG-DC re-projections + prior evals). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more steps = more DC applications interleaved -> slightly lower RMSE (hr>0.0768); if flat, DC has converged at 8 steps and steps is neutral -> revert to 8 (cheaper) and try dc_relax. FALSIFIER: if hr drops, the extra near-off-prior Euler steps add drift -> fewer steps better. (5) BUDGET: 16 steps x n_cg18 ~2x cost ~6min, inside 20min. (6) iter-15 on landing.
